name: Ward
look: a lean pale hound with a short pearl-white coat, dove-grey ears and mask, amber eyes and a thin champagne-gold collar, a faint pearl glow along its spine
temperament: Patient and steady; it walks half a pace ahead of him and never barks without cause
scenePlacement: standing at his side facing the viewer, ears up, tail low
notes: Test-bed creature for Angel Primes; never a dragon (the Elder Dragons are the Drakn line). Use it to try creature art, then move what works into the main roster.
